question: Describe a time you had to make a trade-off between scope and timeline.
intendedUser: Professional in Track-C with early-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-C professionals.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates candidate's trade-off management skills.
exampleAnswer: We had 6 weeks to launch a new feature. Situation: scope was too large. I worked with stakeholders to identify the MVP: core functionality only. We deferred 3 nice-to-have features. Result: launched on time, gathered user feedback, and added deferred features in v2.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
Focusing on process without mentioning personal contribution
Failing to connect to the target role
evaluationCriteria: Clarity, trade-off management, specific examples, measurable outcomes
followUpQuestions: How does this apply to the Track-C role?
Can you provide more specific examples?
What would you do differently next time?
